title: TUYA Global Developer Summit (Europe) 2026: Accelerating Physical AI for the Future of AI Life | news | Tuya Smart
body_markdown:
BERLIN, September 7, 2026 — Tuya Smart (NYSE: TUYA, HKEX: 2391), a global AI cloud platform service provider, hosted its signature TUYA Global Developer Summit (Europe) during IFA 2026, bringing together industry leaders, innovators, and developers to explore how Physical AI can move from emerging technology to real-world applications.


As AI increasingly moves beyond the screen and into the physical world, a new generation of intelligent hardware is beginning to reshape how people live and work. Embodied in connected devices, Physical AI can perceive its surroundings, understand context, and interact with the real world — opening new possibilities across homes, energy, companionship, workplaces, and beyond.


Tina Yu, General Manager of Eurasia, Tuya Smart, opened the event by welcoming attendees and highlighting the significance of cross-industry collaboration in advancing AI innovation.


## AI Is Reshaping the World in Multiple Ways


Alex Yang, Co-founder, COO and CFO of Tuya Smart, delivered a keynote titled “AI Is Redefining Everything,” arguing that AI is reshaping the world in three fundamental ways.


“First, AI is transforming real-world scenarios,” said Yang. “In energy management, for example, Tuya connects to dynamic electricity pricing data from more than 1,000 power companies across Europe and uses AI to optimize household electricity usage strategies in real time, helping improve energy-saving efficiency.


“Second, AI is redefining human-machine interaction,” Yang continued. “Tuya’s answer to this shift is Hey Tuya, a super AI lifestyle assistant. Hey Tuya lets users bring AI beyond the screen with a single sentence — working together with a wide range of physical AI devices and enabling seamless whole-scenario coordination.


“Third, AI is changing the way development happens. Tuya has launched Tuya Cobuilder, an end-to-end physical AI generation system that applies Vibe Coding to AI hardware development. Developers can define products and complete hardware development simply by describing their needs in natural language, significantly lowering the barrier to AI application development.”


## From Connected Homes to AI-Native and Sustainable Living


GIA Group, one of Spain's leading companies in HVAC and home appliances, shared its experience in bringing AI and connected technologies into the home. With nearly a decade of international experience spanning China and Europe, the company has been working with Tuya to integrate air conditioning, hot water, and home appliances into a more connected and intelligent ecosystem.


“Smart homes should go beyond remote control,” said Thomas Chen, Director of Product Department, GIA Group. “They should become an intelligent system that improves both living comfort and energy efficiency. Through our collaboration with Tuya, we have already achieved meaningful improvements in household energy management across multiple European markets. Looking ahead, we will continue integrating AI algorithms more deeply into home scenarios to deliver energy-saving benefits that users can see and experience.”


## Bringing AI Beyond the Screen


Axiom Smart, an AI innovation company from the country of Georgia, is exploring a different dimension of Physical AI through AI companions. Its AI toy, Bubabu, sold out following its debut during the 2025 Christmas season.


Nugzar George Kachukhashvili, Founder and Executive Chairman of Axiom Smart, shared his views on how AI companions will evolve. “AI should not be confined to a screen,” Kachukhashvili said. “It can become a companion with personality, presence, and emotional connection. What people need is not necessarily one general-purpose AI that does everything, but intelligence designed for specific people and scenarios.”


He added: “Working with Tuya's AI + IoT ecosystem, we see an opportunity to bring Physical AI into education, companionship, the home, and many other aspects of everyday life — through the right form factors, interfaces, and roles for each experience.”


## A New Era of Human-Centered Productivity Powered by AI


The summit also explored how AI and intelligent hardware can transform the way people work. Olinkgo, a company focused on AI-powered workplace productivity, introduced its approach to combining intelligent hardware with AI services. Its AI meeting interpretation device, built around high-accuracy, legal-grade translation and enterprise-level data security, shipped more than 2,000 units following its initial launch.


In a presentation titled “A New Era of Human-Centered Productivity Powered by AI,” Belinda Gan, Director of Olinkgo, discussed how AI can help people navigate an increasingly information-intensive world.


“In an era of information overload, the value of AI lies in helping people capture, organize, and make use of the information that matters,” said Gan. “By combining intelligent hardware with AI services, we want to allow people to stay focused during meetings or classes instead of constantly taking notes, while still receiving complete transcripts, translations, and summaries.”


She added, “We look forward to working with Tuya and more ecosystem partners to expand both awareness and adoption of AI-enhanced productivity tools across Europe.”


## Advancing AI-Powered Home Energy Across the Benelux Region


At the summit, Tuya signed a partnership agreement with Elmarc to jointly advance the market distribution, branding, and localized service of AI-native home energy products in the Benelux market.


Founded in 1975, Elmarc is a leading brand operator in the Benelux consumer electronics and home appliance sector, with an extensive distribution network and strong operational expertise. By combining Tuya’s advanced AI-powered energy management technologies with Elmarc’s market reach and local capabilities, the partnership will help bring smarter, more autonomous home energy management solutions to consumers across the region.


Erik van Dalen, CEO of Elmarc, said, “This partnership goes far beyond signing an agreement — it marks an important step forward in our journey to bring next-generation AI energy technology to consumers across the Benelux region. By combining Tuya’s advanced AI energy management technology with Elmarc’s deep local market expertise, well-established distribution network, and brand-building capabilities, we can make home energy management smarter, more convenient, and better matched to consumer needs.


“Today, the energy sector is rapidly moving toward greater intelligence, connectivity, and autonomy, and AI will play a critical role in this transformation. We look forward to standing at the forefront of energy innovation in the Benelux together with Tuya, bringing high-quality AI products to more households and giving consumers real control over their energy management. For Elmarc, this is not just a new partnership — it is a solid step toward the future of AI-powered energy.”


## Building the Next Chapter of Physical AI in Europe


The summit demonstrated how Physical AI is already moving from concept to commercial application through perspectives from across smart homes, energy, AI companionship, and workplace productivity — and surfaced a common theme: the next phase of AI innovation will not be defined by intelligence alone, but by how effectively AI can be embedded into products, environments, and everyday experiences.


Looking ahead, Tuya will continue to deepen its presence in Europe and work alongside developers and ecosystem partners to explore new possibilities for AI-powered living. By lowering the barriers to developing AI-native products and connecting innovation with real-world applications, Tuya aims to help accelerate the next generation of Physical AI across Europe and beyond.


**About Tuya Smart**


Tuya Smart (NYSE: TUYA; HKEX: 2391) is a leading global AI cloud platform service provider dedicated to bringing AI into everyday life. Through its TuyaOpen open-source development framework and universal AI Agent engines, including the AI Agent development platform, Tuya integrates multimodal AI capabilities to lower barriers for AI development, efficiently advancing the realization of AI-driven lifestyles and accelerating AI integration with the physical world. Tuya offers innovative physical AI solutions for smart devices, commercial applications, and industry developers through its cloud computing and spatial intelligence capabilities. It also provides a complete, open, and neutral global AIoT ecosystem.


As of June 30, 2026, the Tuya AI Developer Platform had over 2,092,000 registered AI developers from more than 200 countries and regions.
